review_type: Independent delivery and visual progression review against the senior presentation
overall: The requested reference-inspired visual progression is achieved. Both low-priority findings were corrected and visually verified on the final rendered sheets. No unresolved delivery or layout finding remains in the inspected scope.

strengths.observation: The same Panda, workpiece, goal marker and camera anchor the purpose-to-constraints progression. Large, sparse visuals replace text-only motivation; no early numerical performance claims.
Robot base, q0, scale and viewport remain fixed while target/obstacles and selected IK are progressively added. The sequence makes setup visibly distinct from execution.
The same scene and selected IK stay in view; the moving robot, active target color and corresponding CLF change together. This directly applies the senior slides 17–19 mechanism/state pairing.

The transition criterion appears on page 9, release of the old task on page 10, and EE completion on page 11. Page 12 serves as a recap after each CLF has already been introduced, so its greater density is justified.

Inputs, encoders, cross-attention, bypass and score head retain fixed positions. Page 25 adds selection and control flow below without shifting the learned model, making execution-before/runtime roles clear.
Explicit frames are robust under Beamer handout mode. The 30-frame plan retains 1140 seconds plus 60 seconds of transition buffer.

findings.recommendation: Replace with 목표·환경 정보 or 문제 설정.
findings.resolution: Page 7 now reads 목표·환경 정보, separating scene specification from the QP joint-velocity input.

findings.issue: The 1/3–3/3 markers stay fixed, but 선택한 IK and its main description sit noticeably higher on page 8 than the main headings on pages 6 and 7 because the two vfill regions distribute unequal content. Robot geometry remains correctly fixed.
findings.recommendation: Use a fixed top gap after the step marker and aligned heading/description baselines for all three right columns; reserve the final note region consistently.
findings.resolution: Pages 6–8 use the same fixed gap after the step marker. The three right-column headings and description starts now align; robot geometry and viewport remain unchanged.

nonissues_and_limits: The white lower region on page 24 intentionally reserves the control blocks for page 25; filling it would undermine stable alignment.
The motivation render is a schematic workcell, not trial evidence; speaker notes and Q&A explicitly distinguish it. The main slide does not need a small-font disclaimer.
The stage snapshots are actual recorded end-of-stage configurations rather than interpolated animation; their visual sequence does not establish a new trajectory.
Reference comparison used OOXML geometry and original embedded media, not a native PowerPoint slide render.
The final thanks frame was not part of these visual sheets; its user-authored title/subtitle exception is preserved in the source and plan.
